response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with strong distributed systems, DevOps, and mentoring experience, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments 2014-2015) and his career has centered on web/TypeScript/DLang/Node.js stacks rather than large-scale cloud compute platform or hardware architecture work. Without substantial C++ and cloud-compute-specific production experience, he is a poor fit despite his seniority and leadership qualities.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Demonstrated technical leadership: workshops, talks, mentoring, and DevOps/CI infrastructure setup
Experience with distributed, high-throughput microservices (Sociomantic) handling millions of requests/sec
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments) versus the required 8 years
No clear background in cloud compute platforms, hardware architecture, or storage systems
Career trajectory is largely web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, Ember) rather than infrastructure/platform leadership at the scale implied by the role

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute/hardware architecture background
Strong leadership, mentoring, and distributed systems exposure
